Ozone Therapy (Major Autohemotherapy)

Therapy oxidative-therapy ozone autohematotherapy oxygen-therapy circulation

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Ozone (O3) therapy involves treating blood with ozone to support oxygen utilization and immune function. Major autohemotherapy (MAHT) is the most researched form. Improves tissue oxygenation and supports mitochondrial function.

Type: oxidative

Benefits

  • Improved oxygen utilization
  • Immune modulation
  • Circulation enhancement
  • Mitochondrial support
  • Anti-inflammatory effects

Contraindications

  • Active phase of chronic disease (acute ozone can worsen oxidative stress)
  • Bleeding disorders
  • Severe anemia
  • Pregnancy

Session Duration: 60-90 minutes per session (MAHT)

Frequency Recommendation: 1-2 sessions per week for 4-6 weeks, then maintenance as needed

Cost Range: $100-300 per session
